markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with single-class conformal set [F1], model consensus, and positive margins [F10].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strong invasive probability (5% dataset ECE) |
| Conformal set | Invasive (alpha 10%; 90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability / 88th percentile OOD (12/12 regions) [F6] | Typical image; error AUROC is 70% |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (86%–89% similarity) [F5] | All nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 7) · context · Below-typical score (-0.46) with +0.87 invasive contribution [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.13; +0.69 contribution) [F3] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.20; +0.67 contribution); unreliable (0/20 spot check) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 2, 9) · ↑ invasive · High score (+1.58; +0.47 contribution) · Validated
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 1, 2, 9) · context · 100th-percentile size variation (CV 0.78) [F8]; mean area 41 µm² [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Lesion is InSitu (contrast case BACH_0013, 85% similar), differing in duct confinement (region 11) and lymphocytes.
- Simulated frozen-section artifacts distort morphology or margin calls (validated on 132 test cases across 24 patients).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 5, 6, 2**: Confirm stromal invasion in highest-risk heatmap regions (99%, 95%, 93%, 92% risk).
2. **Regions 0, 1, 2, 9, 11**: Verify infiltrating stroma and pleomorphism versus duct-confined atypia in region 11.
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Check simulated frozen-section margins; tumor suggested at all four margins (215–645 µm).

found: 'Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium' has contribution +0.67, so its arrow must be '↑ invasive'.
The CONCH–MUSK row names Invasive, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
